uploaded_workbook_reading_replay.scope: Actual uploaded rows replayed as hints against a manually verified reference subset; no new visual inference and not full drawing accuracy acceptance

limitations: Full-content reconciliation is an extra visual-model call per page.
A model-verified page inventory is still tentative until checked against the original drawing.
Unmatched local observations are preserved for completeness review and are not procurement entities.
R2 from an old conversation must not be submitted to a new app conversation.
